CLARITY theme runtime assets and five color variants (#233)

* Remove spacing and radius from style theme platform configuration.

Drop the Robin editor section and require only nine color tokens on save, while stripping legacy size keys from existing themes via migration.

* Apply CLARITY theme asset overrides at runtime and seed five themes.

Resolve shell and STAC icons through style-theme assetOverrides, add red/green/purple/orange variants with koboyo icons, and split runtime_app_repository for codeline limits.
